calculation.expression: -(asset_return_3d - cross_sectional_median(asset_return_3d)); active only when lagged cross_asset_dispersion_3d exceeds lagged 120-day rolling median
calculation.description: At each date, use only returns through the prior completed day. Rank the negative three-day return deviation from the cross-sectional median, and activate the signal during above-median lagged cross-asset dispersion. Inactive dates are omitted from the signal artifact.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in 2020-22, 2023-24, and 2025-26; conservative interpretation due to 15-instrument cross-section.
